decision_skill.name: phase_aligned_seasonal_baseline
decision_skill.description: Forecast each horizon position from the observation at the same phase of the most recent complete seasonal cycle, using a robust phase-specific center when multiple cycles are available.
decision_skill.applicability: When a regularly sampled series shows a stable repeating cycle and recent phase-aligned observations are more informative than trend or level extrapolation.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Prefer the phase-aligned seasonal candidate when validation on recent completed cycles shows lower robust forecast error than local-level, damped-trend, weekday-offset, and alternative-lag candidates; break near-ties in favor of the simpler candidate with less extrapolation.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when phase alignment is uncertain, the seasonal pattern is unstable, too few complete cycles exist, or validated competitors materially outperform it.
